tagline.en_US: A self-hosted translation web interface and API powered by open-source translation models. This profile keeps downloaded language models across restarts.

description.en_US: LibreTranslate is an open-source machine translation engine and API. It performs language translations locally without relying on proprietary third-party services. Powered by the Argos Translate library, it provides both an interactive web interface and an API for processing translation requests across multiple languages.
